name: email-tool
description: IMAP/SMTP email: read, search, draft and send mail. One MCP server for all your mailboxes; passwords in the OS keyring.

interface.shortDescription: Read, search, draft and send email from your own mailboxes
interface.longDescription: Runs on your computer. After installing, type "add my mailbox": a page opens where you choose Gmail, Outlook or another mailbox and sign in. Passwords stay in the OS keyring and never pass through the assistant.
